mapper.sql: t."テストID", t."旧テストID", t."テスト番号", t."利用者アカウントID", t."テスト種別", t."レベル", t."書籍", t."分類開始", t."分類終了", t."難易度", t."出題方式", t."出題数", t."完了出題数", t."正解数", t."不正解数", t."状態コード", t."開始日時", t."終了日時", t."最終学習日時", t."有効学習時間ms", t."バージョン"
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM public."JPN_テスト情報" t

SELECT FROM public."JPN_テスト情報" t
ORDER BY t."テストID" DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS "testCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."状態コード" = 'COMPLETED') AS "completedCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t."状態コード" = 'RUNNING') AS "runningCount", COALESCE(round(avg(CASE WHEN t."完了出題数" > 0 THEN t."正解数" * 100.0 / t."完了出題数" END) FILTER (WHERE t."状態コード" = 'COMPLETED')), 0)::int AS "averageScore", COALESCE(sum(t."有効学習時間ms"), 0) AS "totalActiveMs" FROM public."JPN_テスト情報" t WHERE t."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId}
SELECT "テストID" AS "testId", "テスト番号" AS "testNo" FROM public."JPN_テスト情報" WHERE "テスト番号" = #{testNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_テスト情報" ( "テスト番号", "利用者アカウントID", "テスト種別", "レベル", "書籍", "分類開始", "分類終了", "難易度", "出題方式", "出題数", "完了出題数", "正解数", "不正解数", "状態コード", "開始日時", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{testNo}, #{accountId}, #{testType}, #{level}, #{book}, #{categoryFrom}, #{categoryTo}, #{difficulty}, #{mode}, #{questionCount}, 0, 0, 0, 'RUNNING', #{startedAt}, #{accountId}, 'APP' )
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_テスト情報" SET "完了出題数" = #{doneCount}, "正解数" = #{correctCount}, "不正解数" = #{wrongCount}, "状態コード" = #{state}, "最終学習日時" = #{lastStudiedAt}, "有効学習時間ms" = #{activeMs}, "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "テストID" = #{testId}
UPDATE public."JPN_テスト情報" SET "出題数" = #{questionCount}, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "テストID" = #{testId}
UPDATE public."JPN_テスト情報" SET "状態コード" = #{state}, "開始日時" = COALESCE(#{startedAt}, "開始日時"), "終了日時" = #{finishedAt}, "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "テストID" = #{testId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."JPN_テスト情報" WHERE "テストID" = #{testId}

result.column: 単語スナップショットJSON

mapper.sql: e."出題ID", e."テストID", e."単語ID", e."問題ID", e."出題順", e."出題状態", e."最終判定", e."回答回数", e."誤答回数", e."有効学習時間ms", e."回答完了日時", w."見出し語", w."読み", q."問題種別", q."問題文_日本語", q."正解値", q."解説_日本語", q."難易度", e."単語スナップショットJSON"::text AS "単語スナップショットJSON", col."書籍", col."分類"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public."JPN_テスト出題情報" e JOIN public."JPN_単語情報" w ON w."単語ID" = e."単語ID" LEFT JOIN public."JPN_単語問題情報" q ON q."問題ID" = e."問題ID" LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."書籍", c."分類" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" c WHERE c."単語ID" = e."単語ID" ORDER BY c."レベル", c."書籍", c."分類", c."単語SEQ" LIMIT 1 ) col ON TRUE WHERE e."テストID" = #{testId} ORDER BY e."出題順" ASC

SELECT FROM public."JPN_テスト出題情報" e JOIN public."JPN_単語情報" w ON w."単語ID" = e."単語ID" LEFT JOIN public."JPN_単語問題情報" q ON q."問題ID" = e."問題ID" LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."書籍", c."分類" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" c WHERE c."単語ID" = e."単語ID" ORDER BY c."レベル", c."書籍", c."分類", c."単語SEQ" LIMIT 1 ) col ON TRUE WHERE e."テストID" = #{testId} AND e."出題順" = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_テスト出題情報" ( "テストID", "単語ID", "収録ID", "出題順", "問題ID", "出題状態", "単語スナップショットJSON", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{testId}, #{wordId}, #{collectionId}, #{orderNo}, #{questionId}, 'PENDING', COALESCE(#{snapshotJson}, '{}')::jsonb, #{accountId}, 'APP' )
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_テスト出題情報" SET "問題ID" = COALESCE("問題ID", #{questionId}), "出題状態" = #{state}, "最終判定" = #{judgment}, "回答回数" = #{answerCount}, "誤答回数" = #{wrongCount}, "有効学習時間ms" = "有効学習時間ms" + #{activeMs}, "回答完了日時" = #{answeredAt}, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "出題ID" = #{entryId}
mapper.select:
SELECT q."問題ID" AS "questionId", q."単語ID" AS "wordId", q."問題種別" AS "questionType", q."問題番号" AS "questionNo", q."問題文_日本語" AS "questionTextJa", q."正解値" AS "correctValue", q."難易度" AS "difficulty" FROM public."JPN_単語問題情報" q JOIN public."JPN_単語情報" w ON w."単語ID" = q."単語ID" WHERE q."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' AND w."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE'
AND q."問題種別" IN ('C1_READING', 'C2_KANJI')
AND q."問題種別" = 'D_CONTEXT_MEANING'
AND q."問題種別" = 'E_KANJI_USAGE'
AND q."難易度" = #{difficulty}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" cl WHERE cl."単語ID" = q."単語ID" AND cl."レベル" = #{level})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" cb WHERE cb."単語ID" = q."単語ID" AND cb."書籍" ILIKE '%' || #{book} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" cf WHERE cf."単語ID" = q."単語ID" AND cf."分類" >= #{categoryFrom})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" ct WHERE ct."単語ID" = q."単語ID" AND ct."分類" <= #{categoryTo})
ORDER BY
random() w."見出し語キー", q."問題種別", q."問題番号"
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT "選択肢ID" AS "choiceId", "問題ID" AS "questionId", "表示順" AS "orderNo", "選択肢値" AS "value", "選択肢読み" AS "reading", "正解フラグ" AS "correct", "説明_日本語" AS "descriptionJa", "説明_中国語" AS "descriptionZh" FROM public."JPN_単語問題選択肢情報" WHERE "問題ID" = #{questionId} ORDER BY "表示順", "選択肢ID"

SELECT "選択肢ID" AS "choiceId", "問題ID" AS "questionId", "表示順" AS "orderNo", "選択肢値" AS "value", "選択肢読み" AS "reading", "正解フラグ" AS "correct", "説明_日本語" AS "descriptionJa", "説明_中国語" AS "descriptionZh" FROM public."JPN_単語問題選択肢情報" WHERE "問題ID" IN #{id} ORDER BY "問題ID", "表示順", "選択肢ID"

SELECT q."問題ID" AS "questionId", q."単語ID" AS "wordId", q."問題種別" AS "questionType", q."問題番号" AS "questionNo", q."問題文_日本語" AS "questionTextJa", q."正解値" AS "correctValue", q."解説_日本語" AS "explanationJa" FROM public."JPN_単語問題情報" q WHERE q."単語ID" = #{wordId} AND q."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' AND q."問題種別" IN #{type} ORDER BY q."問題種別", q."問題番号" LIMIT 1
